reason: I live here, so naengmyeon isn't the dish I can't get at home, and I already have my spots on Keeaumoku that do a good bowl for less. Nineteen bucks before tax and tip for cold noodles doesn't pull me away from those, and on a Waikiki staycation I'd rather spend on something I really can't find in town.
objection: I can get naengmyeon cheaper a few blocks away, and nothing here tells me the arrowroot noodles are different enough to be worth the extra few dollars.
would_change_my_mind: A friend I trust telling me the chik naengmyeon is noticeably better or unlike anything else on Keeaumoku, or the raw fish version being something I can't get anywhere else nearby.
